Definition: of Hebrew origin (H7205); Ruben (i.e. Reuben), an Israelite:--Reuben.
BiblicalUsage: Of the tribe of Reuben were sealed twelve thousand. Reuben, the firstborn who lost the first place, is named first among the sealed tribes.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the sealing of Reuben is grace upon grace: the tribe that lost the birthright is not lost from the book.
